one_line_value_proposition: An online platform for COPD self-management, with health coaching and connected devices for remote monitoring and education.
target_problem_statement: People with COPD need support to self-manage between reviews. Pulmonary rehabilitation reaches only a small share of those who could benefit, and many people still deteriorate without a plan they can use at home.
why_it_matters_locally: NICE assessed Wellinks in HTG736 and made no recommendation, because it is not used in the NHS and does not have UK regulatory approval. It is listed here so the wider COPD market is visible.
overview: Wellinks is an online platform for self-management of COPD. NICE describes health coaching from respiratory professionals, and a patient app with connected devices such as pulse oximeters and spirometers, for remote monitoring and education.

The supplier also publishes virtual pulmonary rehabilitation, one-to-one clinical coaching and 24/7 nurse triage, delivered with health plans and providers outside the NHS. Less than 4% of eligible COPD patients are reported by the supplier to have access to pulmonary rehabilitation; that figure is supplier-published and is not NHS data.

NICE made no recommendation. The guidance records that Wellinks is not used in the NHS and does not have the relevant UK regulatory approval. This page is a limited view so commissioners can see that part of the market. Wellinks is not available to commission through the NHS HealthStore.
evidence_summary: NICE HTG736 assessed Wellinks and made no recommendation, because the technology is not used in the NHS and does not have UK regulatory approval. The supplier cites a 2023 observational study of remote cardiorespiratory monitoring and COPD hospitalisations. That study is not NHS evidence.
evidence_strength_rationale: NICE did not recommend Wellinks. No NHS deployment or UK regulatory approval is recorded. Published outcomes the supplier cites are not from NHS services.

nice_guidance_refs.note: No recommendation was made. Wellinks is not used in the NHS and does not have UK regulatory approval.

clinical_evidence_detailed.key_results: No recommendation was made for Wellinks.
clinical_evidence_detailed.study_limitation: NICE records that the technology is not used in the NHS and does not have the relevant regulatory approval.

clinical_evidence_detailed.journal: International Journal of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
clinical_evidence_detailed.key_results: The supplier cites this study as evidence that remote cardiorespiratory monitoring is associated with fewer COPD hospitalisations.
clinical_evidence_detailed.study_limitation: Not NHS evidence. NICE did not treat the Wellinks evidence as sufficient for a recommendation. Headline reduction figures on the supplier website are not repeated here.
clinical_evidence_detailed.source_label: Cited by Wellinks (wellinks.com). Lindenauer et al. 2018, also cited on that page, is a general COPD readmission study and is not evidence for this product.
